pathResolution: All texture paths are relative to the assets directory, not this JSON file.
matching: Exact material name or aliases; preserve unmatched materials.
normalConvention: OpenGL tangent space +Y, RGB XYZ mapped from -1..1 to 0..1
notes: Normal texture already bakes four mirrored felt repeats; runtime tiling MUST remain 1x1.
Preserve imported texture coordinates and blend shapes. Apply overrides to a copy of each existing PhysicallyBasedMaterial.
RealityKit PhysicallyBasedMaterial exposes sheen color but not sheen roughness on the installed macOS SDK. Apply sheenColor, keep sheenRoughness as authoring metadata; do not substitute clearcoat.
White baseTint on textured ivory materials preserves baked cream color and blush. Texture color is sRGB; numeric tint values are linear.
